text:
olivia-bizdev: heads-up — after the AWS marketplace flapping yesterday we should formalize partner SEV routing. partners went to the public support queue and it delayed the partner SE response by ~40m.
alan-eng: agree. we need a clear handoff: partner-SE -> eng oncall -> SRE war room, depending on severity. low friction for partners, but strict escalation for sev2/1.
maya-se: can we add a shared channel for marketplace vendor incidents? like #partners-warroom-marketplace. partners can be invited, we keep scramble cadence.
simon-partners: partners will want a single point contact and a doc that lists who to page for each failure type (billing, image/publish, runtime). we should capture portal incidents vs runtime serving incidents separately.
emma-sre: +1. propose this flow:

1) partner files ticket or raises in shared channel
2) if impact > customer-facing -> create war room (#partners-warroom-YYYYMMDD)
3) page oncall SRE & partner SE via PagerDuty
4) open internal incident doc and add partner liaison

paul-ops: can we codify that as a tiny runbook? i can add PD escalation policies. example snippet:

```yaml
severity_map:
  sev1: page: [sre-pd, eng-pd, partner-se-pd]
  sev2: page: [eng-pd, partner-se-pd]
  sev3: notify: [partners-channel, partner-se]
``` 

olivia-bizdev: love that. also we need a marketplace-specific contact: AWS Marketplace has a 24/7 ops contact for listings/entitlements. we should keep that in the doc and a fallback.

simon-partners: i'll collect partner side-oncall names and PD IDs this week. also will ask partners if they prefer being in warroom vs triage calls.

alan-eng: operational details we need in the doc:
- routing rules for public API vs hosted infra vs dedicated customer environments
- whether we open a private war room (customer request) vs public partners channel
- RACI for communications (who posts customer-facing status updates)

maya-se: can we add an SLA commitment for initial response time to partners in the doc? even just internal targets e.g., 15m ack for sev1, 30m for sev2.

emma-sre: yes. SRE will commit to 15m ack for sev1 when paged. we'll add an automated runbook link in the war room topic. suggested runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/partner-sev

oncall-bot: NOTICE: new schedule rotation applied. Next oncall: emma-sre (primary) until 2026-03-28 08:00 UTC.

paul-ops: also adding alert filters: if alert.source == "marketplace" and alert.type in [publish, entitlement] -> route to partner-se queue first, then SRE only if customer impact is detected.

olivia-bizdev: one more thing — joint announcements: if an incident triggers a public partner announcement, bizdev should be looped before any public post. add that as step 0.5 in the runbook.

simon-partners: agreed. i'll draft the partner-facing escalation flow and a short one-pager for partners (where to click, who to ping, expectations). will share tomorrow.

alan-eng: for engineering: i'll add a sample grafana dashboard and a runbook block to copy into any warroom: logs, tail command, top error types, and a quick mitigation checklist.

maya-se: +1. can we also include a short checklist for SI partners for integration breakages (auth tokens, callback endpoints, webhook replay)? they're common causes.

emma-sre: good call. i'll also add a postmortem template that includes partner impact, how we routed, and lessons for partnership processes.

olivia-bizdev: thanks y'all. outcome: simon will draft partner-facing flow, paul will update PD policies, emma & alan will add runbook bits, maya will draft SLA targets. i'll schedule a 30m sync Fri to approve. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: REMINDER: war room creation template: /create-warroom --channel partners-warroom-<date> --lead <owner> --template "partner-sev" 

paul-ops: putting initial PR for PD policies up now. link: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/pd-policies/pull/42

simon-partners: draft ready (internal). sharing in #partnerships-docs in 10.

olivia-bizdev: perfect — thanks team. we'll push this as an official partner escalation playbook next week and link it from partner onboarding.
